title: Counter-evidence — Thin Sketch (challenger claim, earlier creation)
report: The challenger 0x8b9A964d19c13Edf97c7dE797A9424F28f7C0F37 created 'Thin Sketch' on 2026-09-15. The creation is anchored by a signed message: the challenger signed the text 'Thin Sketch by 0x8b9A964d19c13Edf97c7dE797A9424F28f7C0F37 2026-09-15' with the challenger wallet. The work was first published on 2026-09-16 in 'Sketchbook Weekly', listing the challenger as the artist. The original registration evidence gives no date and no anchor at all, while this counter-evidence proves an earlier creation with both an explicit date and a verifiable anchor.
